_note: Phase 2. Everything the class generator draws from. A generated period is a row in periods.json with "generate": true and no roster or schedule pointer; src/systems/roster.js and src/systems/scheduler.js read this file and one integer seed. The seed is the whole input: same seed, same twelve kids, forever. The tell schedule is the seed plus the day, so the same class does different things on Tuesday. The lesson stays authored — voice is what generation is worst at.

bands._note: Where a generated period has to land when the headless sim in src/systems/simulate.js runs it through two play styles. Ranges come from the authored periods' balance table (HISTORY.md): 4th, 5th and 6th land at ideal mastery 74/73/69, restless 72/79/81, missed 7/8/9, and never-checks mastery 51/49/44, restless 93/91/93. A period outside every range is rejected and the schedule re-rolled; the roster never re-rolls on a band miss, because the roster is the class and the class has to be the same on Tuesday.
